topPRs.title: sep/900-902: Whitechain Sepolia U19, U20 and U21 tasks
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds the Upgrade 19, 20 and 21 tasks for **Whitechain Sepolia (chain id 1874)**.

Whitechain is permissioned-only, runs **custom gas token v2**, has its own SuperchainConfig and is
**not in the superchain-registry**, so all three tasks read addresses from a local `addresses.json` via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`.

**Draft deliberately.** Only `sep/900` is signable today; 901 and 902 are blocked drafts with stub validation files, since each upgrade gates on the previous one. This is being shared with the Whitechain team first, so please do not review for approval yet.

| Task | Upgrade | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `sep/900-U19-whitechain-testnet` | v6.0.0 → v7.0.0, OPCM 7.1.17 | **Ready to sign**, simulated clean, hash confirmed at Safe nonce 4 |
| `sep/901-U20-whitechain-testnet` | v7.0.0 → v8.0.0, OPCM 8.0.1 | Draft, blocked |
| `sep/902-U21-whitechain-testnet` | v8.0.0 → v9.0.0, OPCM 9.0.3 | Draft, blocked |

## Rehearsed before being written

The whole sequence was rehearsed on a replica devnet (chain id 18740) that mirrors 1874 on every structural property. There, **U19, the Karst L2 fork, U20 and U21 were all executed**, and each upgrade's post-execution state matched its predicted diff, including the U19 DelayedWETH proxy and the U21 ETHLockbox both landing at the addresses their simulations predicted. The replica tasks are not in this PR; they existed only during the rehearsal.

topPRs.title: sep/124: GIWA Sepolia U20 upgrade (OPCMUpgradeV800)
topPRs.author: ihooni
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds the GIWA Sepolia Testnet (chain id 91342) Upgrade 20 task (`op-contracts/v8.0.0`, `OPCMUpgradeV800`). GIWA Sepolia is permissioned-only, so it rotates PERMISSIONED_CANNON (1) → SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5) and keeps SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) disabled. This is the same shape as sepolia-devnet-3 in sep/107 and Soneium in eth/071.

- Root: the GIWA Sepolia ProxyAdminOwner `0x0B266965c88C78f17e1F9f59784249bf8Da1CB9E`, a nested 2-of-2 of `DunamuUpgradeSafe` `0x3d58…2DB7` and `GIWASecurityCouncil` `0x37FF…bf1C`, each 1-of-1. Both child Safes are named in the task's `[addresses]`.
- Calls:
  1. `OPCM.upgradeSuperchain` on GIWA's own SuperchainConfig `0xEF3a…032d`. Its ProxyAdmin `0x06E9…248C` is owned by the same ProxyAdminOwner.
  2. `OPCM.upgrade`.
- Starting anchor: a single-chain super root from `check-super-root` against `https://sepolia-rpc.giwa.io` (finalized L2 block 40513435, timestamp 1793858551). I also recomputed it independently from the block header and the `L2ToL1MessagePasser` storage root.
- `expectedValidationErrors` is `OVERRIDES-L1PAOMULTISIG,OVERRIDES-CHALLENGER,SYSCON-130,SCKDG-SHAPE,SCKDG-10`. The codes come from GIWA's own ProxyAdminOwner and Challenger, its own SuperchainConfig, and the missing SUPER_CANNON_KONA game. It matches sep/107 devnet-3.
- Depends on the registry bump in #1605. Thanks for landing it.

---

## For Task PRs

**Task path**: `src/tasks/sep/124-U20-giwa-sepolia`

**Tenderly simulation link**:

### Simulation Checklist

> These boxes must be checked before your PR can be merged.

- [ ] I have run a Tenderly simulation for this task
- [x] I have reviewed and understand all state changes in the simulation
- [x] I have verified that every state change reflects the **exact expected value** (e.g., if setting an `absolutePrestate`, confirm the precise `bytes32` hash matches expectations)
- [x] All state changes match the expected behavior documented in `VALIDATION.md`
- [x] I can explain every state diff to reviewers and signers

### Task Checklist

- [x] `README.md` is complete with accurate task description
- [x] `VALIDATION.md` documents expected state changes with correct domain/message hashes
- [x] Task status is set appropriately
- [x] All TODOs in generated files have been addressed

---

## Additional context

Validation so far, besides `just simulate` / `just simulate-stack` on both child Safes (both pass, identical state diff):

- **Independent hashes.** I recomputed the root and both child safe tx hashes with `getTransactionHash` from the task calldata, outside the task tooling:
  - Root: `Multicall3DelegateCall`, delegatecall, nonce 13.
  - Child: `Multicall3.aggregate3Value([approveHash])`, delegatecall, nonces 1 / 2.
  - All three match.
- **Anvil fork run.** On a Sepolia fork I ran both child `execTransaction`s (approveHash), then the root `execTransaction`. All succeeded; the root used about 1.78M gas.
  - Every slot in VALIDATION.md was read before and after.
  - The simulation labels the AnchorStateRegistry slots one slot off; VALIDATION.md uses the 3.9.0 layout: `anchorGame` at 0x02, `startingAnchorRoot` at 0x03/0x04, `respectedGameType`/`retirementTimestamp` at 0x06.
- **Post-upgrade games on the fork.**
  - The registry proposer can create a game type 5 game. It resolves `DEFENDER_WINS` at creation, and `rootClaimByChainId(91342)` returns the output root.
  - Game type 1 creation reverts with `NoImplementation(1)`.
  - A non-proposer reverts with `BadAuth`, and a wrong root claim reverts with `BadExtraData`.
- `cannonKonaPrestate` is the kona-client/v1.7.0-rc.2 value used by every registry chain in the U20 tasks. It is never encoded for this chain: the Safe hashes are identical with a different prestate.

GIWA operates and signs this task itself, and the GIWA team will facilitate `approve` / `execute`. We plan to execute on 2026-11-11 and won't send any other transaction from these three Safes before then, so the pinned nonces stay valid.

topPRs.title: sep: int-mig-upg-0 OPCM v9 upgrade + migrate (executed)
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
Records two executed devnet tasks and the template change they needed.

**Depends on #1591 (OPCMUpgradeV900) and #1582 (OPCMMigrateV900)**, which this branch merges; rebase once they land.

## Template
`OPCMUpgradeV900`: optional `permitEthLockboxDeployment` (chain IDs). For chains whose portal has no ETHLockbox, adds the `PermittedProxyDeployment=ETHLockbox` extra instruction; without it the v9 OPCM reverts with `ETHLockbox` (`0x391074c9`). Setup requires each listed chain to be configured and to have no lockbox.

## Tasks
| Task | Tx |
|---|---|
| `120-int-mig-upg-0-opcm-upgrade-v900` | [`0x62189e05…c6dc`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x62189e057776d05fab11a99f6ba2a6d732737b702077ecbdb3dad323ff52c6dc) |
| `121-int-mig-upg-0-opcm-migrate-v900` | [`0xee5c8bd1…e15c`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xee5c8bd191d877c1d2745e44da7bc8684f84f87227e8ef42a174b1ed7417e15c) |

Both used v9 OPCM `0xe09c…2ea9` (9.0.5), not a released `op-contracts/v9.0.0`. 121's `cannonKonaPrestate` (`0x03723b53…b041`) was built at `kona-node/v1.9.0` with infrastructure-services#1430.

## Gas
Sepolia charged well above forge's local estimates (13.6M vs ~5.1M for 120; 17.0M vs ~4.2M for 121), so default `just execute` runs out of gas (`GS013`). Executed with `--gas-estimate-multiplier` 300 and 500 respectively; that justfile change is **not** in this PR.
